1.

Jerusalem, God’s city, In faith we behold thee. At the thought of thy glory Our heart rejoices.

2.

Thou secure haven of rest, Where soon we shall rest, Where freely our soul shall enjoy All that here she longs for.

3.

Who can declare here The joy that awaits us then, When we with all the saints Shall praise Thee, Lord.

4.

No tongue can tell, What joy and peace it will be In eternities’ eternity To dwell with God and the Lamb.

5.

The “hidden manna” then, Known in the wilderness here, God’s Son, the living bread of God, Shall ever nourish us there.

6.

God Himself and the Lamb then Shall be light and temple, And the redeemed hosts shall fully understand God’s mystery therein.
